RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Collapsing Core
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Molten Brand. Keep only 1 brand. Store 25% of owner damage instead of 20%, up to 48 instead of 36. Deal 12 base damage plus stored damage, but reduce radius to 1.5 cells and hit at most 3 enemies. One active branch per core. Switch outside combat with no active brands.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Linked Fuses
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Molten Brand. Early detonation chains through your brands within 6 cells and clear sight, up to 3. Each deals 6 base damage plus 70% of stored damage. Expiry and death do not start chains. Consume the whole chain before damage; Quick Fuse refunds only once per command. One active branch per core.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Lone Warden
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Legion Command. New ordinary projections become wardens: double their health multiplier and raise their damage multiplier by 50%, using 2 summon slots. Keep only 1 ordinary projection; further summons neither heal nor extend it. Resonance nodes are unchanged. Switch legion branches outside combat with no ordinary projections present.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Rotating Front
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Legion Command. Ordinary projection damage falls by 15%. After a projection damages an enemy, Rally at the owner's feet to withdraw. Rest within 4 cells and clear sight of the owner for 2 seconds. Issue Rally or Focus to attack again: a rested projection's first hit deals 6 extra base damage, at most once per owner every 8 seconds. Guard mode holds position and waits for orders.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Breach Follow-up
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Molten Brand. If early detonation damages the selected branded target, leave a breach for 3 seconds. Your next basic hit on that target deals 6 extra base damage and consumes it. Keep one breach per owner; other targets in a chain do not gain one.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Tempered Afterheat
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Molten Brand. On natural expiry, gain shield equal to 20% of stored damage, up to 8, for 4 seconds, at most every 6 seconds. Death and early detonation do not trigger this. Shield does not stack or gain healing amplification; a stronger existing shield is retained.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Banner Echo
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Legion Command. Within 4 seconds after a Rally or Focus order, the first damaging hit by your ordinary projection grants you 6 shield for 3 seconds, at most every 8 seconds. Returning to guard does not trigger it; repeated orders cannot reset the cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Relay Reload
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Prismatic Magazine. Your damaging ranged basic hit tags one target for 3 seconds. Your ordinary projection hitting it consumes the tag and restores 1 prismatic round, at most every 6 seconds. A full magazine preserves the tag. Keep one target per owner; resonance nodes do not count.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shield-fed Magazine
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Prismatic Magazine. Gain a manual reload command: spend 12 existing shield to restore 1 prismatic round, with a 6-second cooldown. A full magazine, insufficient shield or inability to act spends nothing. Does not reset passive reload or skill cooldowns. Voluntary spending is not hostile damage or shield break.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Rift Scatter
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After actually moving with an existing movement ability, your next basic hit within 3 seconds releases a 60-degree cone toward the target, reaching 6 cells and dealing 4 base damage to up to 3 enemies. Walls block it; at most once every 6 seconds. Grants no movement ability. Frontline Exchange also primes it; ordinary walking does not.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Fire Adjustment
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After casting an enemy-targeted ability, a basic hit on a different enemy within 3 seconds deals 6 extra base damage, at most every 4 seconds. Molten Brand, Detonate and Focus Legion do not qualify. Repeated hits on the same target cannot consume this setup; keep only one setup.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Close Cover
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: When your ranged basic hit damages an enemy within 6 cells, grant one other friendly humanlike colonist within 4 cells and clear sight 6 shield for 3 seconds, at most every 6 seconds. Cannot shield yourself; no eligible nearby ally means no trigger.
